rules.sentence: Diagnosis of ulnar neuropathy begins with a thorough history and physical examination.
When doubt exists, NCS and EMG can be used to localize and confirm the diagnosis and assess the severity of the neuropathy.[9]
If surgical intervention is indicated, electrodiagnostic testing can aid the surgeon in identifying the exact area of nerve entrapment.
Electrodiagnostic testing can also differentiate between ulnar neuropathy, C8 radiculopathy, plexopathies, and other forms of mononeuropathy.
